sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: We like stories about leaders who have big ideas,
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢关于那些胸怀大志的领导者的故事，

sentences.en: who defy the odds and pursue their goals with messianic purpose.
sentences.zh: 他们不畏艰难，以神圣的使命感追求目标。

sentences.en: Think of Winston Churchill in World War II,
sentences.zh: 想想二战中的温斯顿·丘吉尔，

sentences.en: or Abraham Lincoln during the Civil War.
sentences.zh: 或是内战时期的亚伯拉罕·林肯。

sentences.en: But what happens when a leader's vision is the wrong one?
sentences.zh: 但当领导者的愿景出现偏差时会发生什么？

sentences.en: How do we think about people who dream big,
sentences.zh: 我们该如何看待那些心怀宏图大志，

sentences.en: only to invite disaster?
sentences.zh: 却招致灾难的人？

sentences.en: At such times, we might prefer a more cautious style,
sentences.zh: 在那种时候，我们或许更偏爱一种谨慎的风格，

sentences.en: someone who plays the odds.
sentences.zh: 一个懂得权衡利弊的人。

sentences.en: Those leaders might not score historic triumphs,
sentences.zh: 这些领导者或许不会取得历史性的辉煌胜利，

sentences.en: but they rarely cause catastrophes.
sentences.zh: 但他们很少酿成灾难。

sentences.en: Thousands of years ago, the Greek poet Archilochus summed up this idea.
sentences.zh: 几千年前，希腊诗人阿尔基洛科斯总结了这一观点。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说：

sentences.en: the fox knows many things, but the hedgehog knows one big thing.
sentences.zh: 狐狸知道许多事情，而刺猬只知道一件大事。

sentences.en: That parable has been the subject of much debate over the last 2,500 years,
sentences.zh: 在过去的2500年里，这则寓言一直是许多争论的主题，

sentences.en: what exactly Archilochus meant.
sentences.zh: 即阿尔基洛科斯究竟是什么意思。

sentences.en: This is psychologist Phil Tetlock.
sentences.zh: 这位是心理学家菲尔·特洛克。

sentences.en: Various people have offered various interpretations.
sentences.zh: 不同的人给出了不同的解读。

sentences.en: Some people coming out on the side of the hedgehog,
sentences.zh: 有些人站在刺猬这一边，

sentences.en: saying the hedgehog will trump the fox,
sentences.zh: 认为刺猬会胜过狐狸，

sentences.en: and other people saying, no, it really means the fox is going to do better.
sentences.zh: 而另一些人则说，不对，这实际上意味着狐狸会表现得更好。

sentences.en: There are different ways to think about the metaphor,
sentences.zh: 思考这个隐喻有不同的方法，

sentences.en: but here's how I see it.
sentences.zh: 但我是这样看的。

sentences.en: If a fox wants dinner, it has many options.
sentences.zh: 如果一只狐狸想吃晚饭，它有很多选择。

sentences.en: It can chase down a hedgehog.
sentences.zh: 它可以去追捕一只刺猬。

sentences.en: It can find something else to eat.
sentences.zh: 它可以找别的东西吃。

sentences.en: It can even go without food for a day.
sentences.zh: 它甚至可以一天不吃东西。

sentences.en: But if you're a hedgehog being chased by a fox,
sentences.zh: 但如果你是一只被狐狸追赶的刺猬，

sentences.en: you don't have multiple goals.
sentences.zh: 你就没有那么多目标了。

sentences.en: You have one overarching idea.
sentences.zh: 你只有一个至高无上的核心想法。

sentences.en: Bill Tetlock thinks this metaphor also describes
sentences.zh: 比尔·特洛克认为，这个隐喻也描述了

sentences.en: two different cognitive styles among people.
sentences.zh: 人类的两种不同认知风格。

sentences.en: Foxes have different strategies for different probleMs.
sentences.zh: 狐狸针对不同的问题有不同的策略。

sentences.en: They're comfortable with nuance.
sentences.zh: 它们适应细微的差别。

sentences.en: They can live with contradictions.
sentences.zh: 它们能与矛盾共存。

sentences.en: Hedgehogs focus on the big picture.
sentences.zh: 刺猬则专注于宏观大局。

sentences.en: They see every problem through the lens of a single organizing principle.
sentences.zh: 它们透过单一的组织原则来看待每一个问题。

sentences.en: The hedgehogs are more parsimonious, more decisive.
sentences.zh: 刺猬更加简练，更加果断。

sentences.en: In most MBA programs, they'd probably be viewed as better leadership material.
sentences.zh: 在大多数MBA项目中，他们可能会被视为更好的领导者苗子。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we're listening back to our May 2017 show
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》节目中，我们将重温2017年5月的节目，

sentences.en: that tells the story of a hedgehog,
sentences.zh: 该节目讲述了一个刺猬般的人物的故事，

sentences.en: a surgeon who changed the world in daring ways.
sentences.zh: 他是一位以勇敢的方式改变世界的 chirurgien（外科医生）。

sentences.en: His bold style made him a pioneer in what has today become the transgender movement.
sentences.zh: 他大胆的风格使他成为当今跨性别运动的先驱。

sentences.en: It also propelled him to create one of the world's first international medical missions.
sentences.zh: 这也推动他创建了世界上最早的国际医疗救援任务之一。

sentences.en: Like other hedgehogs, this surgeon experienced outside success
sentences.zh: 与其他刺猬一样，这位外科医生曾取得过世俗的成功，

sentences.en: until one day, he didn't.
sentences.zh: 直到有一天，他不再成功了。

sentences.en: It's just a goddamn disaster.
sentences.zh: 这真是一场该死的灾难。

sentences.en: An awful thing.
sentences.zh: 一件可怕的事情。

sentences.en: Greatness and tragedy.
sentences.zh: 伟大与悲剧并存。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 本周尽在《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Sandy Stone was born in 1936 in the midst of the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 桑迪·斯通于1936年出生于大萧条时期。

sentences.en: Her parents gave her a Hebrew name.
sentences.zh: 她的父母给她取了一个希伯来名字。

sentences.en: It was Zelig Ben-Natan.
sentences.zh: 那就是泽利格·本-纳坦。

sentences.en: Zelig Ben-Natan.
sentences.zh: 泽利格·本-纳坦。

sentences.en: A boy's name.
sentences.zh: 一个男孩的名字。

sentences.en: That's because her parents thought she was a boy.
sentences.zh: 那是因为她的父母以为她是个男孩。

sentences.en: But from a very early age, she knew she was a girl.
sentences.zh: 但从很小的时候起，她就知道自己是个女孩。

sentences.en: This was a long time ago, decades before the modern trans movement.
sentences.zh: 这很久以前了，比现代跨性别运动早了几十年。

sentences.en: When Sandy was a child, there were no words,
sentences.zh: 当桑迪还是个孩子的时候，没有任何词汇，

sentences.en: no language to describe what she knew about herself.
sentences.zh: 没有任何语言来描述她对自己的认知。

sentences.en: It was lonely, it was disorienting, it was puzzling, confusing, scary.
sentences.zh: 那是孤独的，令人迷失的，令人困惑的、混乱的、可怕的。

sentences.en: It was all of those things.
sentences.zh: 所有这些感觉都有。

sentences.en: It stayed like that for Sandy all the way into adulthood.
sentences.zh: 桑迪一直保持着这种状态，直到成年。

sentences.en: She went to school, became a recording engineer, moved to the Bay Area.
sentences.zh: 她上学，成了一名录音工程师，搬到了湾区。

sentences.en: All the while, everyone thought she was a man.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，所有人都以为她是个男人。

sentences.en: She kept searching for help.
sentences.zh: 她不断寻求帮助。

sentences.en: In the San Francisco phone book, she found a promising lead.
sentences.zh: 在旧金山电话簿里，她找到了一个很有希望的线索。

sentences.en: It was a group for gay men.
sentences.zh: 那是一个同性恋男士的团体。

sentences.en: When she called, they asked if she was gay.
sentences.zh: 当她打电话时，他们问她是不是同性恋。

sentences.en: She said she wasn't.
sentences.zh: 她说她不是。

sentences.en: So they sent her away and told her to try another group.
sentences.zh: 于是他们打发她走，让她去找另一个团体。

sentences.en: The outfit they recommended surprised Sandy.
sentences.zh: 他们推荐的机构让桑迪感到意外。

sentences.en: It was the San Francisco Police Department.
sentences.zh: 那是旧金山警察局。

sentences.en: It turned out that the police department was running a counseling unit of sorts,
sentences.zh: 原来警察局开办了一种咨询中心，

sentences.en: which they did for the population of transgender people
sentences.zh: 这是他们为居住在旧金山田德隆区的跨性别群体设立的，

sentences.en: that lived in the San Francisco Tenderloin,
sentences.zh: 居住在旧金山田德隆区，

sentences.en: which was sort of the down-and-out skid row section of town
sentences.zh: 那可以说是城里破败贫民窟的地段，

sentences.en: that tended to collect people who couldn't afford to live anywhere else
sentences.zh: 往往聚集着那些买不起其他地方房子的人，

sentences.en: or who had run out of options.
sentences.zh: 或者已经走投无路的人。

sentences.en: Trans people who ended up in the Tenderloin
sentences.zh: 最终流落到田德隆区的跨性别者，

sentences.en: were at high risk for drug addiction and prostitution.
sentences.zh: 面临着极高的吸毒和卖淫风险。

sentences.en: They were social outcasts.
sentences.zh: 他们是社会的边缘人。

sentences.en: When Sandy got in touch with the police to ask for help,
sentences.zh: 当桑迪联系警方寻求帮助时，

sentences.en: the first thing they did was to dissuade her from acting on her feelings.
sentences.zh: 他们做的第一件事就是劝阻她不要顺从自己的感受。

sentences.en: And they actually tried to discourage me by taking on a tour
sentences.zh: 他们实际上试图通过带我参观来打击我，

sentences.en: that reminded me of Dante being led down into the lower circles of hell.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起但丁被引领进入地狱深层。,

sentences.en: They really showed me the worst of everything
sentences.zh: 他们真的向我展示了最糟糕的一切，

sentences.en: and then said,
sentences.zh: 然后说：

sentences.en: are you sure you still want to go ahead with what you're thinking of?
sentences.zh: 你确信还要继续你脑子里想的那件事吗？

sentences.en: And to be perfectly honest,
sentences.zh: 坦白说，

sentences.en: I was not quite sure what I was thinking of.
sentences.zh: 我不太确定自己脑子里在想什么。

sentences.en: I was just trying to collect information.
sentences.zh: 我只是在收集信息。

sentences.en: And I think it would be safe to say
sentences.zh: 而且我认为可以说，

sentences.en: that that's what we were all doing at that time.
sentences.zh: 我们当时所有人都在这样做。

sentences.en: Still, the referral to the police turned out to be a stroke of luck.
sentences.zh: 不过，向警方求助的结果证明是一次运气的眷顾。

sentences.en: The cops told her that a center at Stanford University
sentences.zh: 警察告诉她，斯坦福大学的一个中心

sentences.en: had recently started performing what were then called sex change operations.
sentences.zh: 最近开始实施当时被称为变性手术的手术。

sentences.en: They didn't refer me to Stanford as much as talk about it,
sentences.zh: 与其说他们把我推荐给斯坦福，不如说是在谈论它，

sentences.en: as the great unattainable goal,
sentences.zh: 把它当作那个遥不可及的伟大目标，

sentences.en: the great beautiful shining star in the sky.
sentences.zh: 天空中那颗美丽耀眼的巨星。

sentences.en: After years of suffering and loneliness and confusion,
sentences.zh: 经历了多年的痛苦、孤独和困惑之后，

sentences.en: the Stanford program felt like a beacon.
sentences.zh: 斯坦福的项目就像一座灯塔。

sentences.en: Sandy felt she might finally have a chance
sentences.zh: 桑迪觉得她终于有机会

sentences.en: to live a more honest, satisfying life.
sentences.zh: 过上更诚实、更满意的生活了。

sentences.en: But first, she had to convince the gatekeeper
sentences.zh: 但首先，她必须说服那个把守大门的人，

sentences.en: who stood between her and the person she wanted to become.
sentences.zh: 他横亘在她与她想成为的人之间。

sentences.en: He ran what was then called the gender dysphoria program at Stanford.
sentences.zh: 他负责当时所谓的斯坦福性别不安项目。

sentences.en: His name was Don Lobb.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫唐·洛布。

sentences.en: The gatekeeper of Stanford's gender dysphoria program was a hedgehog.
sentences.zh: 斯坦福性别不安项目的守门人是一个刺猬似的人物。

sentences.en: From a very early age, he had a big-picture idea.
sentences.zh: 从小到大，他都有一个宏大的构想。

sentences.en: He wanted to help people.
sentences.zh: 他想帮助人们。

sentences.en: He wanted to help a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 他想帮助很多人。

sentences.en: As a small child, when kids in his school
sentences.zh: 作为一个小孩子，当学校里的孩子们

sentences.en: were asked to donate money to a charity,
sentences.zh: 被要求向慈善机构捐款时，

sentences.en: his classmates contributed a dime.
sentences.zh: 他的同班同学捐了一毛钱。

sentences.en: Don worked in a vegetable garden an entire summer
sentences.zh: 唐在菜地里干了一整个夏天的活，

sentences.en: to raise a whopping $10.
sentences.zh: 筹集了整整10美元。

sentences.en: Now, I got a letter, a preserved letter from it
sentences.zh: 现在，我收到了一封信，一封保存完好的信，

sentences.en: that my mother wrote to some of her friends
sentences.zh: 是我母亲写给她的几个朋友的，

sentences.en: saying, Don, he's done something that nobody has ever done.
sentences.zh: 上面说，唐，他做了一件从来没有人做过的事。

sentences.en: Don's father feared his little boy was consumed
sentences.zh: 唐的父亲担心他的小儿子

sentences.en: with being a do-gooder,
sentences.zh: 一心只想做好事，

sentences.en: that he would turn out to be a failure at business.
sentences.zh: 将来在商业上会一败涂地。

sentences.en: His father was right.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲猜对了。

sentences.en: Don Lobb became a doctor.
sentences.zh: 唐·洛布成了一名医生。

sentences.en: When he came to Stanford in the 1960s,
sentences.zh: 当他在20世纪60年代来到斯坦福时，

sentences.en: he was a young, ambitious plastic surgeon,
sentences.zh: 他是一个年轻、雄心勃勃的整形外科医生，

sentences.en: very much in awe of his prize-winning colleagues.
sentences.zh: 非常崇拜他那些屡获殊荣的同事。

sentences.en: Coming to Stanford, I was overshadowed
sentences.zh: 来到斯坦福，我感到自己被

sentences.en: by the hugeness of what people were doing,
sentences.zh: 人们所做事情的巨大意义所掩盖了，

sentences.en: the importance of it.
sentences.zh: 那种重要性。

sentences.en: So I knew that I had to do something,
sentences.zh: 所以我知道我必须做点什么，

sentences.en: like maybe, you know, I've got to do this
sentences.zh: 比如，你知道的，我迟早得做点什么，

sentences.en: somewhere along the line,
sentences.zh: 在某个时间节点上，

sentences.en: because everybody else here is doing it.
sentences.zh: 因为这里的每个人都在这样做。

sentences.en: Don was looking for a place to make his mark.
sentences.zh: 唐一直在寻找一个能让自己崭露头角的地方。

sentences.en: One day, a colleague walked out of an examination room
sentences.zh: 一天，一位同事从检查室走出来，

sentences.en: and came up to him.
sentences.zh: 朝他走来。

sentences.en: I said, Don, I want you to see a patient.
sentences.zh: 我说，唐，我想让你看一个病人。

sentences.en: It's a good case.
sentences.zh: 这是一个好病例。

sentences.en: You might not like it.
sentences.zh: 你可能不会喜欢。

sentences.en: It's a sex change.
sentences.zh: 这是一场变性手术。

sentences.en: Remember, this was 1968.
sentences.zh: 记住，那是1968年。

sentences.en: I said, Dave, send that patient away.
sentences.zh: 我说，戴夫，把那个病人打发走。

sentences.en: I'm a Catholic boy from the Midwest,
sentences.zh: 我是来自中西部的天主教男孩，

sentences.en: and I'm at Stanford.
sentences.zh: 而我在斯坦福。

sentences.en: We don't do those things.
sentences.zh: 我们不做那种事。

sentences.en: But Don's colleague insisted he meet the patient.
sentences.zh: 但唐的同事坚持要他去见见这个病人。

sentences.en: To be clear, this patient was not Sandy Stone.
sentences.zh: 需要说明的是，这位患者并不是桑迪·斯通。

sentences.en: And he said, Do me a favor and go in that room.
sentences.zh: 他说，帮我个忙，进那间屋子去。

sentences.en: So I went in the room and talked to the patient.
sentences.zh: 于是我走进屋里，跟患者交谈起来。

sentences.en: And I said, Now, why do you want a sex change?
sentences.zh: 我说，那么，你为什么想变性？

sentences.en: She said, Well, I was born,
sentences.zh: 她说，嗯，我生来如此，

sentences.en: and this is what I should be.
sentences.zh: 这正是我本该成为的样子。

sentences.en: I said, Well, when did you decide that?
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，你是什么时候决定这样的？

sentences.en: She said, I didn't decide it.
sentences.zh: 她说，我没做决定。

sentences.en: This is what I was born with from day one.
sentences.zh: 从出生第一天起，我就是这样的。

sentences.en: This patient was a pioneer.
sentences.zh: 这位患者是个先驱。

sentences.en: No one on the West Coast had received what's come to be known today
sentences.zh: 西海岸没有人接受过后来被称为

sentences.en: as gender reassignment surgery or gender confirmation surgery.
sentences.zh: 性别重置手术或性别确认手术的治疗。

sentences.en: In fact, the surgery had been rarely performed across the whole world.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这种手术在全世界都极少有人施行。

sentences.en: Don was an unlikely choice of doctor.
sentences.zh: 唐并不是做这种医生的理想人选。

sentences.en: He was, by his own account, a prim man from the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 据他自己所说，他是一个来自中西部的古板男人。

sentences.en: But although Don initially blanched at the idea of gender reassignment surgery,
sentences.zh: 尽管唐起初对性别重置手术的想法退避三舍，

sentences.en: he felt a shiver of excitement.
sentences.zh: 但他还是感到了一丝兴奋。

sentences.en: He didn't send the patient away.
sentences.zh: 他没有把患者赶走。

sentences.en: Instead, he went looking for information.
sentences.zh: 相反，他开始四处搜寻资料。

sentences.en: He consulted with psychiatrists and the few surgeons around the world
sentences.zh: 他咨询了精神病学家以及世界上为数不多的几位外科医生，

sentences.en: who'd already performed this kind of surgery.
sentences.zh: 他们已经做过这种手术。

sentences.en: What prompted you, this sort of Catholic doctor from the Midwest,
sentences.zh: 是什么促使你，这样一个来自中西部的天主教医生，

sentences.en: to basically take this on?
sentences.zh: 基本上接下了这摊事？

sentences.en: It seems like an unlikely fit.
sentences.zh: 这看起来很不搭调。

sentences.en: It was a wonderful opportunity to do a big thing
sentences.zh: 这是一个做大事的绝佳机会，

sentences.en: and to help a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 而且能帮助很多人。

sentences.en: Altruism and ambition were always tightly woven in Don's identity.
sentences.zh: 利他主义和雄心壮志在唐的个性中一向紧密交织。

sentences.en: He wasn't interested in superficial cosmetic work.
sentences.zh: 他对表面的美容整形不感兴趣。

sentences.en: He wanted to change the world.
sentences.zh: 他想改变世界。

sentences.en: He decided to take the leap.
sentences.zh: 他决定放手一搏。

sentences.en: In November 1968, Don Laugh performed California's first gender reassignment surgery.
sentences.zh: 1968年11月，唐·劳布施行了加州第一例性别重置手术。

sentences.en: We were more than prepared for all the things that might happen.
sentences.zh: 我们对可能发生的所有情况都做好了充分的准备。

sentences.en: And the surgery went fine.
sentences.zh: 手术很顺利。

sentences.en: It took about three and a half hours.
sentences.zh: 大约花了三个半小时。

sentences.en: We did it with the skin graft method.
sentences.zh: 我们用的是皮瓣移植法。

sentences.en: No problem.
sentences.zh: 没有问题。

sentences.en: Don soon became one of the world's leading experts on gender reassignment surgery.
sentences.zh: 唐很快成为世界领先的性别重置手术专家之一。

sentences.en: He started a program.
sentences.zh: 他发起了一个项目。

sentences.en: His reputation grew.
sentences.zh: 他的声誉越来越高。

sentences.en: A reputation for being a good surgeon and a tough gatekeeper.
sentences.zh: 一个既是好医生又是个严厉把关人的声誉。

sentences.en: He turned away many people because he felt they weren't good candidates for surgery.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝了许多人，因为他觉得他们不适合做手术。

sentences.en: Sandy Stone vividly remembers her first appointment with him in the mid-70s.
sentences.zh: 桑迪·斯通清晰地记得70年代中期她第一次去见他的情景。

sentences.en: I go in and sit down and Don is behind his desk and he's wearing his white coat.
sentences.zh: 我走进去坐下，唐坐在办公桌后面，穿着白大褂。

sentences.en: And he's very distinguished looking and calm and very friendly and open.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很有气场、很冷静，也非常友好和坦率。

sentences.en: And he says, well, what can I do for you?
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，我能为你做点什么？

sentences.en: And I say, the first thing that comes into my head, which is, I think I'm a woman.
sentences.zh: 我说出了脑子里浮现的第一件事，那就是，我觉得我是个女人。

sentences.en: Now, the scene we have is Don behind his desk and me.
sentences.zh: 当时的情景是，唐坐在办公桌后面，而我坐在前面。

sentences.en: I have a long black beard and wild black hair.
sentences.zh: 我留着长长的黑胡子，顶着一头凌乱的黑发。

sentences.en: I'm wearing a blue shirt, jeans, and engineer's boots.
sentences.zh: 我穿着蓝色衬衫、牛仔裤和工程靴。

sentences.en: I do not exactly look like I'm thinking of myself as a stereotypical woman.
sentences.zh: 我看起来绝对不像是一个把自己当作传统女性的人。

sentences.en: And Don looks at me and says, really?
sentences.zh: 唐看着我说，真的吗？

sentences.en: And I say, what should I do?
sentences.zh: 我说，我该怎么做？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm totally, I'm completely open to anything.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我完全、完全对一切持开放态度。

sentences.en: I really don't know what I should do, what direction I should move in, what's right, what's wrong.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道我该做什么，我该朝哪个方向发展，什么对，什么错。

sentences.en: And I'm looking to Donald to tell me.
sentences.zh: 我在指望唐纳德来告诉我。

sentences.en: And in my memory of the thing, Donald then says, well, the first thing you should do is lose the beard.
sentences.zh: 在我的记忆中，唐纳德接着说，嗯，你首先应该做的是把胡子刮了。

sentences.en: That was the beginning of Sandy's long transformative journey.
sentences.zh: 那是桑迪漫长蜕变之旅的开始。

sentences.en: It was a tough journey.
sentences.zh: 那是一段艰难的旅程。

sentences.en: Don wanted Sandy to be sure she was making the right decision.
sentences.zh: 唐希望桑迪确信自己做出的是正确的决定。

sentences.en: So before he would even consider surgery, Sandy says he told her she would have to live openly and fully as a woman for one full year.
sentences.zh: 因此，在考虑手术之前，桑迪说他告诉她，她必须以女性身份公开且完全地生活整整一年。

sentences.en: It was a requirement based on the reality of the time.
sentences.zh: 这是一个基于当时现实的要求。

sentences.en: No one, not Sandy, nor Don, knew what might come from these surgeries in the long term.
sentences.zh: 没有人，无论是桑迪还是唐，知道这些手术长远来看会带来什么结果。

sentences.en: These were early days.
sentences.zh: 那是早期阶段。

sentences.en: It was all a bit of an experiment, a shot in the dark.
sentences.zh: 这一切有点像是一场实验，一次盲目的尝试。

sentences.en: It was fraught.
sentences.zh: 充满了风险。

sentences.en: It was fraught for everyone.
sentences.zh: 对每个人来说都充满风险。

sentences.en: And it was fraught because at that time it was not clear what would happen later.
sentences.zh: 充满风险是因为当时还不清楚以后会发生什么。

sentences.en: We didn't have very many examples of transgender people who had had surgery who went on to have fulfilling lives
sentences.zh: 我们没有多少跨性别手术者的先例，他们能够过上充实的生活，

sentences.en: and lived to tell about it, which is to say came back later and reported back to the program.
sentences.zh: 并且活着讲述这一切，也就是说后来回来并向项目组汇报。

sentences.en: They were experimenting on the fringe of what both medicine and society thought was acceptable.
sentences.zh: 他们是在医学和社会的接受边缘进行实验。

sentences.en: Don was taking risks with his professional reputation.
sentences.zh: 唐是在拿自己的职业声誉冒险。

sentences.en: Sandy was taking risks with her life.
sentences.zh: 桑迪是在拿自己的生命冒险。

sentences.en: There was one moment, Sandy says, when she and Don clashed.
sentences.zh: 桑迪说，有一次她和唐发生了冲突。

sentences.en: The conflict boiled down to their cognitive styles.
sentences.zh: 冲突归根结底在于他们的认知风格不同。

sentences.en: At some point, he asked me if I were 100% committed to wanting surgery.
sentences.zh: 在某个时候，他问我是否对想要手术有百分之百的决心。

sentences.en: And I said, no, I'm not.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，我没有。

sentences.en: I'm probably 99.9%.
sentences.zh: 我大概有99.9%的决心。

sentences.en: I think anyone who's 100% committed to anything is probably crazy.
sentences.zh: 我认为任何对某事有百分之百决心的人大概都疯了。

sentences.en: You have to have some reservations in life.
sentences.zh: 你在生活中必须有所保留。

sentences.en: You have to have an overview of everything that you're doing and have alternative plans if what you're looking for doesn't work out.
sentences.zh: 你必须对你所做的一切有一个全局观，如果你的目标没有实现，还要有备选方案。

sentences.en: And Don said, well, in that case, you're not eligible for surgery.
sentences.zh: 唐说，嗯，既然如此，你不符合手术资格。

sentences.en: You have to be 100% committed.
sentences.zh: 你必须有百分之百的决心。

sentences.en: It took a mediated session with Don's assistant for the two of them to resolve the conflict.
sentences.zh: 经过唐的助手的调解，两人才化解了这场冲突。

sentences.en: But the incident revealed something about the way a hedgehog moves through the world.
sentences.zh: 但这件事揭示了刺猬在世上行事的方式。

sentences.en: Hedgehogs are decisive.
sentences.zh: 刺猬是果断的。

sentences.en: Don could not understand anything less than 100% commitment, even if the 0.1% of doubt was simply a way to say, I'm human.
sentences.zh: 唐无法理解任何低于百分之百决心的态度，即使那0.1%的怀疑只是在说，我是个人类。

sentences.en: How can I be absolutely sure?
sentences.zh: 我怎么能绝对确定呢？

sentences.en: Sandy tells another story of a time she came in for an appointment wearing jeans and a t-shirt.
sentences.zh: 桑迪讲了另一件事，有一次她穿着牛仔裤和T恤去赴约。

sentences.en: Don asked her why she wasn't dressed like a woman.
sentences.zh: 唐问她为什么不穿得像个女人。

sentences.en: He'd missed the bell-bottom jeans and tie-dye revolution happening right outside his window.
sentences.zh: 他错过了窗外正在上演的喇叭裤和嬉皮风革命。

sentences.en: It was the kind of thing that could have led to a fight, except for one thing.
sentences.zh: 这本可能引发一场争吵，但有一点除外。

sentences.en: Sandy understood where Don was coming from.
sentences.zh: 桑迪理解唐的出发点。

sentences.en: She knew that underneath the tough exterior, he really wanted to help.
sentences.zh: 她知道在那强硬的外表下，他是真的想帮忙。

sentences.en: And not just in a medical sense.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是在医学意义上。

sentences.en: More than anything, Don wanted Sandy to live a life where she didn't feel like an outcaSt.
sentences.zh: 唐最希望的是，桑迪能过上一种不觉得自己是个局外人的生活。

sentences.en: He wanted his people to be totally unremarkable, to just fit in, to be able to live their lives,
sentences.zh: 他希望他的人完全不引人注目，能够融入集体，能够过上自己的生活，

sentences.en: to be able to be inconspicuous and just get along.
sentences.zh: 能够不显眼并与人和睦相处。

sentences.en: And that's a good thing to want for 99% of your waking day,
sentences.zh: 而这对于你清醒时间的99%来说是个很好的愿望，

sentences.en: is just to be able to live your life,
sentences.zh: 那就是能够过上你自己的生活，

sentences.en: to be able to live with other people and not rub people the wrong way.
sentences.zh: 能够与其他人一起生活而不惹人生厌。

sentences.en: Sandy Stone successfully underwent surgery in 1977.
sentences.zh: 桑迪·斯通于1977年成功接受了手术。

sentences.en: When I interviewed Sandy, I told her that her story reminded me of another case that Don told me about.
sentences.zh: 当我采访桑迪时，我告诉她，她的故事让我想起了唐跟我讲过的另一个病例。

sentences.en: It's interesting because Don first came to my attention because of another case involving cleft lip surgery.
sentences.zh: 很有意思，因为唐最初引起我的注意是因为另一个涉及唇裂手术的病例。

sentences.en: And it's so striking that as you're saying this, I'm sort of hearing echoes of that other work as well,
sentences.zh: 太惊人了，当你这么说的时候，我仿佛听到了那项工作的回响，

sentences.en: this drive that he had to just help people to essentially live what he would think of as being a normal life,
sentences.zh: 他那种纯粹为了帮助人们过上他心目中的正常生活的动力，

sentences.en: a life that they're not ostracized, a life that they're not feeling like they're outcasts,
sentences.zh: 一种不被排挤的生活，一种不觉得自己是局外人的生活，

sentences.en: that they're functioning, they can get an education if they're a child,
sentences.zh: 一种能够正常运转的生活，如果是孩子就能接受教育，

sentences.en: that they can get a job if they're an adult, that they can be happy.
sentences.zh: 如果是成年人就能找到工作，能够感到幸福。

sentences.en: And I feel there's something actually very Midwestern about that idea.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这种想法其实非常具有中西部特色。

sentences.en: That's the word.
sentences.zh: 就是这个词。

sentences.en: That word you said is correct.
sentences.zh: 你说的那个词很准确。

sentences.en: Don wanted people to be happy.
sentences.zh: 唐希望人们快乐。

sentences.en: Don did it professionally.
sentences.zh: 唐是以此为业的。

sentences.en: His job was to help people to be happy.
sentences.zh: 他的工作就是帮助人们获得快乐。

sentences.en: And for that, I owe him a lifetime debt.
sentences.zh: 为此，我欠他一辈子的恩情。

sentences.en: I would not have done anything, I think, that I did after the 1980s if it weren't for Don Laub,
sentences.zh: 要不是因为唐·劳布，我想我不会做任何我在80年代之后做过的事，

sentences.en: or the 70s, rather, if it weren't for Don Laub.
sentences.zh: 或者说70年代之后，要不是因为唐·劳布。

sentences.en: Sandy went on to become a prominent writer and theorist
sentences.zh: 桑迪后来成为了一位杰出的作家和理论家，

sentences.en: and eventually helped found the academic discipline of transgender studies.
sentences.zh: 并最终协助创立了跨性别研究这一学术领域。

sentences.en: When she considers Don's influence on her life,
sentences.zh: 当她回想唐对她人生的影响时，

sentences.en: she homes in on his willingness to pursue a big idea with single-minded purpose.
sentences.zh: 她聚焦于他以专一的目标去追求伟大理念的意愿。

sentences.en: Do you go for the big one, or do you accept something less?
sentences.zh: 你是去追求那个宏大的目标，还是接受次要的选择？

sentences.en: And many of us accept something less because we don't want to take the risk.
sentences.zh: 我们当中许多人接受了次要选择，因为我们不想承担风险。

sentences.en: And then we may go through life, maybe, maybe we'll be happy with our measure.
sentences.zh: 然后我们可能会度过一生，也许，也许我们会对自己的所得感到满意。

sentences.en: Or maybe we'll say, what if I had gone for what I really wanted?
sentences.zh: 或者我们会说，如果我追求了我真正想要的呢？

sentences.en: What would that have been like?
sentences.zh: 那会是怎样的情景？

sentences.en: Maybe I would have died.
sentences.zh: 也许我会死。

sentences.en: Yeah, maybe I would have.
sentences.zh: 是的，也许我会。

sentences.en: But I didn't.
sentences.zh: 但我没有。

sentences.en: I beat the odds.
sentences.zh: 我战胜了逆境。

sentences.en: Don's leap into the unknown, his willingness to bet his professional reputation on a big idea,
sentences.zh: 唐向未知的跃升，他愿意拿自己的职业声誉去押注一个伟大的理念，

sentences.en: his confidence in his own judgment, it had all paid off.
sentences.zh: 他对自身判断的信心，这一切都得到了回报。

sentences.en: The hedgehog had won.
sentences.zh: 刺猬赢了。

sentences.en: But pursuing a big idea with determination doesn't always pay off.
sentences.zh: 但带着决心追求一个伟大的理念并不总是能得到回报。

sentences.en: And when a hedgehog fails, the fall can be painful.
sentences.zh: 当刺猬失败时，跌落可能是痛苦的。

sentences.en: Don Laub knows about that part of the story, too.
sentences.zh: 唐·劳布也经历过故事的那个部分。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.en: According to the ancient Greek poet Archilochus,
sentences.zh: 根据古希腊诗人阿尔基洛库斯的说法，

sentences.en: the fox knows many things, but the hedgehog knows one big thing.
sentences.zh: 狐狸知道许多事情，但刺猬知道一件大事。

sentences.en: Psychologist Phil Tetlock says the metaphor describes two kinds of people.
sentences.zh: 心理学家菲尔·特洛克说，这个隐喻描述了两种人。

sentences.en: Small-picture tacticians are foxes.
sentences.zh: 注重细节的战术家是狐狸。

sentences.en: Big-picture strategists are hedgehogs.
sentences.zh: 胸怀全局的战略家是刺猬。

sentences.en: Before Don Laub became a world-renowned gender reassignment surgeon,
sentences.zh: 在唐·劳布成为世界著名的性别重置外科医生之前，

sentences.en: he had another big idea.
sentences.zh: 他有过另一个伟大的想法。

sentences.en: It started this way.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的。

sentences.en: One day, a colleague asked him if he could help with the surgery.
sentences.zh: 一天，一位同事问他能不能帮忙做个手术。

sentences.en: The patient was a child from Mexico.
sentences.zh: 患者是个来自墨西哥的孩子。

sentences.en: This was a 14-year-old boy who had no other deformity than his cleft lip and palate.
sentences.zh: 这是一个14岁的男孩，除了唇腭裂之外没有任何畸形。

sentences.en: But because of it, the boy was shunned.
sentences.zh: 但正因为如此，这个男孩被疏远了。

sentences.en: A group of priests had driven him north, all the way to Stanford, to get him help.
sentences.zh: 一群神父一路向北带他来到斯坦福，来寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Don immediately understood that the cleft lip wasn't just a medical problem.
sentences.zh: 唐立即明白，兔唇不仅仅是一个医疗问题。

sentences.en: He had not gone to school.
sentences.zh: 他没有上过学。

sentences.en: He had no educational advancement.
sentences.zh: 他没有任何教育背景。

sentences.en: He had no friends.
sentences.zh: 他没有朋友。

sentences.en: The surgery to repair the cleft lip and palate was simple and quick.
sentences.zh: 修复唇腭裂的手术既简单又快捷。

sentences.en: It was so easy, and it gave this child a real chance in life.
sentences.zh: 这太容易了，却给了这个孩子在生活中真正的机会。

sentences.en: Don says performing the surgery made him feel really good.
sentences.zh: 唐说，实施这项手术让他感觉非常好。

sentences.en: As someone with deep religious roots and a Catholic education that emphasized helping the poor,
sentences.zh: 作为一个有着深厚宗教根基和强调救助穷人的天主教教育背景的人，

sentences.en: Don felt this was the kind of patient he wanted to serve.
sentences.zh: 唐觉得这就是他想要服务的患者类型。

sentences.en: He turned to the priest who'd brought the boy from Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他转向那个把男孩从墨西哥带的神父。

sentences.en: I asked him, are there other patients in Mexico like this?
sentences.zh: 我问他，墨西哥还有其他这样的患者吗？

sentences.en: They said, well, the place is full of them.
sentences.zh: 他们说，哦，那地方到处都是。

sentences.en: So we bought our airplane ticket and went down to Mexicali and asked for a clinic.
sentences.zh: 于是我们买了机票，去了墨西卡利，并找了一家诊所。

sentences.en: Just like that.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: Where a fox may have calculated the odds, considered the upside and the downside,
sentences.zh: 如果说狐狸可能会权衡利弊、深思熟虑，

sentences.en: the hedgehog simply picked up and went.
sentences.zh: 刺猬则二话不说直接前行。

sentences.en: In Mexicali, Don found a dusty border town in the desert where the people were very poor.
sentences.zh: 在墨西卡利，唐发现了一个尘土飞扬的沙漠边境小镇，那里的人们非常穷。

sentences.en: Most of the houses were made of packing crates at that time,
sentences.zh: 当时大多数房子都是用木条箱搭成的，

sentences.en: and there was no paving in Mexicali of 200,000 people.
sentences.zh: 拥有20万人口的墨西卡利甚至没有铺过柏油路。

sentences.en: Mexicali's main medical facility was an old wood home.
sentences.zh: 墨西卡利主要的医疗设施是一栋老旧的木屋。

sentences.en: It had a dirt floor for part of it.
sentences.zh: 它的部分地面还是泥土地。

sentences.en: The back part of the clinic was used to raise fighting cocks.
sentences.zh: 诊所的后半部分被用来养斗鸡。

sentences.en: A rational fox may have calculated the risks and backed down.
sentences.zh: 理性的狐狸可能会权衡风险然后退缩。

sentences.en: Not Don.
sentences.zh: 但唐没有。

sentences.en: He recruited local health officials to get word out that they would be providing free surgeries for children
sentences.zh: 他招募了当地的卫生官员，散布消息说他们将为患有

sentences.en: with cleft lips and burn scars.
sentences.zh: 唇裂和烧伤疤痕的儿童提供免费手术。

sentences.en: The clinic was quickly packed.
sentences.zh: 诊所很快就挤满了人。

sentences.en: It was 10.30 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 那是早上10点半。

sentences.en: In that desert, there had not been rain there for three years.
sentences.zh: 在那片沙漠里，已经三年没下过雨了。

sentences.en: Hot in the morning, it was about 106 degrees already.
sentences.zh: 早晨就很热，气温已经达到了106华氏度左右。

sentences.en: You couldn't touch anything metal because you'd burn your hand.
sentences.zh: 你不能碰任何金属东西，否则手会被烫伤。

sentences.en: The first patient I saw was sitting there with a bag on his head with two little peep holes.
sentences.zh: 我看到的第一个病人坐在那里，头上套着一个有两个小窥孔的麻袋。

sentences.en: So I said, why the bag?
sentences.zh: 于是我说，为什么要戴麻袋？

sentences.en: Behind those peep holes, the boy was hiding his face in shame.
sentences.zh: 透过那些窥孔，那个男孩正羞耻地把脸藏起来。

sentences.en: Don asked if he could take a look.
sentences.zh: 唐问他能不能看一下。

sentences.en: So he got the bag off, and he had a burn scar to pull this eyelid down.
sentences.zh: 于是他拿掉了麻袋，发现他有一道把眼睑往下拉的烧伤疤痕。

sentences.en: A simple thing to repair.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很容易修复的小问题。

sentences.en: As with Sandy, Don wanted to make the little boy unremarkable.
sentences.zh: 就像对待桑迪一样，唐希望让这个小男孩变得不再起眼。

sentences.en: He wanted him to lead an ordinary life, unmarked by stigma and shame.
sentences.zh: 他希望他能过上普通的生活，不被污名和羞耻所标记。

sentences.en: That first trip was just a fact-finding mission, a way to see if there was a need.
sentences.zh: 第一次行程只是一次事实调查任务，旨在看看是否有这种需求。

sentences.en: By the time Don went back to Stanford, a plan had formed in his mind.
sentences.zh: 就在唐返回斯坦福的时候，一个计划在他心中形成了。

sentences.en: He wanted to recruit the best doctors from the United States and fly them to Mexico
sentences.zh: 他想从美国招募最优秀的医生，并用飞机把他们送到墨西哥，

sentences.en: to perform free surgeries on children with birth defects.
sentences.zh: 为患有先天缺陷的儿童实施免费手术。

sentences.en: He recruited surgical residents to join skilled surgeons on the trips.
sentences.zh: 他招募了外科住院医师，与熟练的外科医生一起参加这些行程。

sentences.en: He found pilots willing to transport medical equipment.
sentences.zh: 他找到了愿意运输医疗设备的飞行员。

sentences.en: Hedgehogs have charisma.
sentences.zh: 刺猬自带人格魅力。

sentences.en: They can see the shining city on the hill so clearly
sentences.zh: 他们能把山顶上那座闪耀的城市看得如此清晰，

sentences.en: that everyone around them starts to see it too.
sentences.zh: 以至于周围的每个人也开始看到了它。

sentences.en: Everybody jumped on it.
sentences.zh: 大家都积极响应。

sentences.en: I had to hide when I go in the hospital
sentences.zh: 我走进医院时不得不躲藏起来，

sentences.en: because people wanted to get in on this.
sentences.zh: 因为人们都想参与进来。

sentences.en: In 1966, the official medical missions began.
sentences.zh: 1966年，官方的医疗任务开始了。

sentences.en: Now, it's important to remember that at this time,
sentences.zh: 现在，重要的是要记住，在当时，

sentences.en: the idea of plastic surgeons going abroad to provide free surgery
sentences.zh: 整形外科医生出国提供免费手术的想法

sentences.en: was almost unheard of.
sentences.zh: 几乎是闻所未闻的。

sentences.en: There were fewer parameters of how international aid organizations should operate.
sentences.zh: 当时对于国际救援组织应该如何运作的限制较少。

sentences.en: Don was flying by the seat of his pants.
sentences.zh: 唐当时全凭直觉行事。

sentences.en: Every few months, the doctors would descend on Mexicali.
sentences.zh: 每隔几个月，医生们就会蜂拥至墨西卡利。

sentences.en: They'd throw themselves into four marathon days of back-to-back surgeries and consultations.
sentences.zh: 他们会全身心投入到连续四天高强度的马拉松式手术和会诊中。

sentences.en: Over the years, they'd come back, again and again,
sentences.zh: 多年来，他们一次又一次地回来，

sentences.en: performing more than 2,000 surgeries in all.
sentences.zh: 总共实施了2000多台手术。

sentences.en: One of Don's first patients was a little boy named Eugenio.
sentences.zh: 唐最早的病人之一是一个叫尤金尼奥的小男孩。

sentences.en: He was the boy who'd worn the bag over his head.
sentences.zh: 他就是那个头上套着麻袋的男孩。

sentences.en: Don repaired the scarred eyelid and still remembers the boy's first reaction.
sentences.zh: 唐修复了有疤痕的眼睑，至今仍记得这个男孩的最初反应。

sentences.en: He had a very nice, huge smile.
sentences.zh: 他露出了一个非常好看的巨大微笑。

sentences.en: On a follow-up trip, Don tracked Eugenio down.
sentences.zh: 在随后的回访中，唐找到了尤金尼奥。

sentences.en: He shook hands and everything like that, even as a young kid.
sentences.zh: 他会握手以及诸如此类的礼节，尽管还是个小孩子。

sentences.en: And he said, I have friends at school now.
sentences.zh: 他说，我现在在学校有朋友了。

sentences.en: Don loved it.
sentences.zh: 唐对此感到很高兴。

sentences.en: It's a real happiness.
sentences.zh: 这是一种真正的幸福。

sentences.en: It's a source of happiness.
sentences.zh: 这是幸福的源泉。

sentences.en: It's the best description.
sentences.zh: 这是最好的描述。

sentences.en: If anything, Don had a, I would describe it as a very,
sentences.zh: 如果要说的话，唐有一种，我把它描述为非常，

sentences.en: and I think he would accept this.
sentences.zh: 我想他也会接受这一点。

sentences.en: I think it was a very sort of missionary zeal.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种非常类似于传教士般的热忱。

sentences.en: This is plastic surgeon Howard Holderness.
sentences.zh: 这是整形外科医生霍华德·霍尔德尼斯。

sentences.en: He was part of the team of residents helping perform surgeries in Mexicali.
sentences.zh: 他是协助在墨西卡利实施手术的住院医师团队的一员。

sentences.en: Howard says that Don's vision drove the whole team.
sentences.zh: 霍华德说，唐的愿景推动了整个团队。

sentences.en: I think he felt very close to trying to do things that not only practice medicine
sentences.zh: 我想他非常热衷于尝试做这样的事情：不仅是实践医学

sentences.en: and all of its forms of science and everything,
sentences.zh: 及其所有的科学形式以及方方面面，

sentences.en: but the art of medicine and some of the spiritual aspects of being a good doctor.
sentences.zh: 还有医学的艺术，以及做一个好医生的某些精神层面。

sentences.en: He was doing more than surgeries.
sentences.zh: 他做的不只是手术。

sentences.en: Don was developing a program that could set an example for others to follow around the world.
sentences.zh: 唐正在开发一个项目，可以为世界各地的人们树立效仿的榜样。

sentences.en: One day, about two years into the Mexico program,
sentences.zh: 有一天，大约在墨西哥项目开展两年后，

sentences.en: a woman arrived at the clinic with her young son.
sentences.zh: 一位妇女带着她的小儿子来到诊所。

sentences.en: His name was Salvador.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫萨尔瓦多。

sentences.en: Compared with the other patients, Salvador had a more severe birth defect.
sentences.zh: 与其他患者相比，萨尔瓦多的先天缺陷更为严重。

sentences.en: He had bilateral clefts, two clefts rather than one.
sentences.zh: 他患有双侧唇裂，是两个裂口而不是一个。

sentences.en: When you have the bilateral, the muscles are cut twice.
sentences.zh: 当你是双侧时，肌肉会被切断两次。

sentences.en: So when you smile, they pull out.
sentences.zh: 所以当你笑的时候，它们会向外拉扯。

sentences.en: If they're repaired, they pull in.
sentences.zh: 如果修复了，它们就会向内拉扯。

sentences.en: See?
sentences.zh: 明白吗？

sentences.en: So every time he would have a facial expression, it would be awful.
sentences.zh: 所以他每次做面部表情时，都会显得很糟糕。

sentences.en: You'd see these teeth on both sides.
sentences.zh: 你会看到两侧露出的牙齿。

sentences.en: Salvador was a perfect candidate for surgery.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多是手术的完美候选人。

sentences.en: That is, until a doctor on the team gave the boy a thorough physical
sentences.zh: 直到团队中的一名医生对这名男孩进行了全面的身体检查，

sentences.en: and listened to his heart with a stethoscope.
sentences.zh: 并用听诊器听了他的心跳。

sentences.en: His mother brought him in, and the pediatrician listened.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲把他抱了进来，儿科医生听了听。

sentences.en: And he goes, whoosh, whoosh, whoosh.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，呼——呼——呼——。

sentences.en: The heart sounds.
sentences.zh: 心音。

sentences.en: These were not normal sounds.
sentences.zh: 这些不是正常的声音。

sentences.en: The boy's heart had a hole in it.
sentences.zh: 这个男孩的心脏有个洞。

sentences.en: The risk of proceeding with surgery was small, but potentially fatal.
sentences.zh: 继续手术的风险很小，但可能是致命的。

sentences.en: They gave the mother the bad news.
sentences.zh: 他们把这个坏消息告诉了母亲。

sentences.en: We can't operate because we don't have the equipment in Mexicali
sentences.zh: 我们不能做手术，因为我们在墨西卡利没有设备

sentences.en: to do the heart catheterization or anything like that
sentences.zh: 来进行心脏导管检查或类似的事情，

sentences.en: or even get to the EKG today.
sentences.zh: 甚至今天连做心电图都做不了。

sentences.en: So Don and his team turned away the mother and the little boy.
sentences.zh: 于是，唐和他的团队拒绝了这位母亲和小男孩。

sentences.en: I should say here that we're going only on Don's account of what happened.
sentences.zh: 我在这里应该说明一下，我们只是根据唐对发生的事情的叙述。

sentences.en: The medical records from that era are incomplete,
sentences.zh: 那个时代的病历并不完整，

sentences.en: and we weren't able to find the mother.
sentences.zh: 而且我们没能找到这位母亲。

sentences.en: A few months after sending the child away,
sentences.zh: 把孩子送走几个月后，

sentences.en: Don and his team were back in Mexicali.
sentences.zh: 唐和他的团队又回到了墨西卡利。

sentences.en: The mother and her son were waiting for them again.
sentences.zh: 这位母亲和她的儿子又在等他们了。

sentences.en: Salvador, she told them, was shunned.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他们，萨尔瓦多被孤立了。

sentences.en: He had no friends.
sentences.zh: 他没有朋友。

sentences.en: Other children called him El Monstre, the monster.
sentences.zh: 其他孩子叫他“El Monstre”，也就是怪物。

sentences.en: The mother said, this child has no chance in life.
sentences.zh: 母亲说，这个孩子在生活中没有机会了。

sentences.en: You've got to fix it.
sentences.zh: 你必须治好他。

sentences.en: Don's heart went out to the little boy.
sentences.zh: 唐对这个小男孩充满了同情。

sentences.en: He explained the danger again.
sentences.zh: 他再次解释了危险性。

sentences.en: The risk was small, but it did mean that things could go seriously wrong.
sentences.zh: 风险很小，但确实意味着事情可能会出现严重的差错。

sentences.en: Don held the stethoscope up to the mother's ears.
sentences.zh: 唐把听诊器举到母亲的耳边。

sentences.en: Listen, she can hear it.
sentences.zh: 听，她能听到。

sentences.en: Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh.
So the answer again was no.
sentences.zh: 所以答案依然是不行。

sentences.en: More months passed.
sentences.zh: 又过了几个月。

sentences.en: Don returned to the clinic.
sentences.zh: 唐回到了诊所。

sentences.en: So did the mother.
sentences.zh: 母亲也来了。

sentences.en: Por favor.
sentences.zh: 求求你。

sentences.en: Please, doctor.
sentences.zh: 求求你，医生。

sentences.en: Can you see this child has no life?
sentences.zh: 难道你看不出这孩子根本没有生活可言吗？

sentences.en: This was a critical moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关键时刻。

sentences.en: Don could again have said no.
sentences.zh: 唐本可以再次拒绝。

sentences.en: Medical protocol said that was the right call.
sentences.zh: 医疗规范说那是正确的决定。

sentences.en: But Don also knew that without surgery,
sentences.zh: 但唐也知道，如果不做手术，

sentences.en: Salvador would always be an outcaSt.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多将永远是一个被社会抛弃的人。

sentences.en: Could he have tried to take the boy back to Stanford,
sentences.zh: 他本可以尝试把男孩带回斯坦福吗？

sentences.en: where heart surgeons could have assisted with his care?
sentences.zh: 那里有心脏外科医生可以协助他的护理？

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: But that would have been complicated, expensive,
sentences.zh: 但这将是复杂、昂贵的，

sentences.en: and a drain on critical resources from the project in Mexico,
sentences.zh: 并且会消耗墨西哥项目中的关键资源，

sentences.en: resources that were helping hundreds of other children.
sentences.zh: 而这些资源本可以用来帮助其他数百名儿童。

sentences.en: So Don did what Don always did.
sentences.zh: 所以唐做了他一直以来都会做的事。

sentences.en: He took a look at the child, took a deep breath, and said,
sentences.zh: 他看了一眼孩子，深吸了一口气，说道，

sentences.en: OK, we'll do it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们做。

sentences.en: I feel like that's why I existed, is for this judgment.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就是我存在的意义，就是为了做出这种判断。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm not there to take care of little pimples.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我来这里不是为了处理小粉刺的。

sentences.en: I'm there to do the tough cases.
sentences.zh: 我是来处理棘手病例的。

sentences.en: So this was putting it right on the line.
sentences.zh: 所以这是把一切都押上了。

sentences.en: You got to do it or put your tail between your legs and get out of there.
sentences.zh: 你必须放手去做，否则就只能夹着尾巴逃跑。

sentences.en: It's been nearly 50 years since Don Law performed that surgery
sentences.zh: 距离唐·劳在墨西哥墨卡利

sentences.en: on a six-year-old boy in Mexicali, Mexico.
sentences.zh: 给一个六岁男孩做那场手术，已经过去将近50年了。

sentences.en: He's had thousands of patients since then,
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他有过成千上万的病人，

sentences.en: but the details of that day are still vivid in his mind.
sentences.zh: 但那一天的细节依然历历在目。

sentences.en: The morning of the surgery,
sentences.zh: 手术那天早晨，

sentences.en: the boy went through the standard pre-surgery lab tests and checkup,
sentences.zh: 男孩做了术前常规化验和检查，

sentences.en: an IV was started, and he received extra glucose
sentences.zh: 扎上了静脉输液，并输入了额外的葡萄糖，

sentences.en: in case his blood sugar was low from stomach worMs.
sentences.zh: 以防他因为肚里的寄生虫导致血糖过低。

sentences.en: And then the boy walked by himself into the operating room.
sentences.zh: 然后，男孩独自一人走进了手术室。

sentences.en: And he gets on the operating table himself
sentences.zh: 他自己爬上了手术台，

sentences.en: because he trusts the whole world.
sentences.zh: 因为他对整个世界都充满信任。

sentences.en: The surgery began.
sentences.zh: 手术开始了。

sentences.en: First, the child was anesthetized.
sentences.zh: 首先，给孩子进行了麻醉。

sentences.en: So that went fine.
sentences.zh: 一切都很顺利。

sentences.en: It went perfect.
sentences.zh: 完美无缺。

sentences.en: No problem at all.
sentences.zh: 完全没有问题。

sentences.en: Then Don and his team began the surgery.
sentences.zh: 接着，唐和他的团队开始做手术。

sentences.en: When we were operating, everything was going perfect.
sentences.zh: 当我们动手术时，一切都进行得完美无瑕。

sentences.en: And then, just like that, it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 然而，就在那一瞬间，情况变了。

sentences.en: Anesthesia, I said, boys, we have no pulse.
sentences.zh: 我对手麻医生说，伙计们，我们没有脉搏了。

sentences.en: They tried everything.
sentences.zh: 他们尝试了一切方法。

sentences.en: CPR, medicine to jumpstart the heart.
sentences.zh: 心肺复苏，强心针。

sentences.en: Nothing worked.
sentences.zh: 什么都不起作用。

sentences.en: Don suspected a blood clot.
sentences.zh: 唐怀疑是血栓。

sentences.en: The boy was dead.
sentences.zh: 男孩死了。

sentences.en: They put away their surgical tools.
sentences.zh: 他们收起了手术器械。

sentences.en: They wheeled the body to the morgue.
sentences.zh: 他们把遗体推到了太平间。

sentences.en: All the while, Don's heart was starting to race.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，唐的心跳开始加速。

sentences.en: He was working in a foreign country.
sentences.zh: 他在异国他乡工作。

sentences.en: And he had made a risky judgment call in violation of medical protocol.
sentences.zh: 而且他做出了一项违反医疗规程的冒险决定。

sentences.en: And my mind is going a thousand miles a minute.
sentences.zh: 我的脑子里在一秒钟闪过无数个念头。

sentences.en: Why am I here in Mexico?
sentences.zh: 我为什么要在墨西哥？

sentences.en: Why did I get into this?
sentences.zh: 我为什么要蹚这浑水？

sentences.en: What the hell is the matter with you?
sentences.zh: 你到底脑子有什么毛病？

sentences.en: Here you are in a foreign country.
sentences.zh: 你现在身处异国他乡。

sentences.en: You're going to end up in jail.
sentences.zh: 你最后会进监狱的。

sentences.en: It's just a goddamn disaster.
sentences.zh: 这简直是一场该死的灾难。

sentences.en: An awful thing.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了。

sentences.en: And of course, there was the boy's mother, waiting anxiously outside for news of her son.
sentences.zh: 当然，男孩的母亲还在外面焦急地等待她儿子的消息。

sentences.en: Don remembers stepping out of the operating room and walking up to her.
sentences.zh: 唐记得自己走出手术室，向她走去。

sentences.en: He told her there'd been complications, that they had tried hard, but the boy had died.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她发生了并发症，他们尽力了，但孩子还是死了。

sentences.en: The mother began to sob.
sentences.zh: 母亲开始抽泣。

sentences.en: But then, Don says, she did something surprising.
sentences.zh: 但唐说，随后她做了一件让人意想不到的事。

sentences.en: She asked him why he was upset.
sentences.zh: 她问他为什么要难过。

sentences.en: She said, you should be happy, because the child is seeing God with a complete face.
sentences.zh: 她说，你应该感到高兴，因为孩子带着一张完整的脸去见上帝了。

sentences.en: Don had expected accusation and anger.
sentences.zh: 唐原本以为会遭到指责和愤怒。

sentences.en: Instead, he encountered a mother who leaned heavily on her faith.
sentences.zh: 相反，他遇到了一位笃信信仰的母亲。

sentences.en: Don says she was comforted by the thought that her child was now repaired and beautiful and at home with God.
sentences.zh: 唐说，一想到孩子现在已经修复好、漂漂亮亮地回到了上帝身边，她就得到了慰藉。

sentences.en: Salvador was finally at peace.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多终于安息了。

sentences.en: Don stared at the mother.
sentences.zh: 唐凝视着这位母亲。

sentences.en: He was speechless, not just because of what she'd said, but because he was struck by another thought.
sentences.zh: 他哑口无言，不仅是因为她的话，还因为他脑子里冒出了另一个念头。

sentences.en: The mother didn't know this, but Salvador's face was not repaired.
sentences.zh: 这位母亲并不知道，萨尔瓦多的脸并没有修复好。

sentences.en: He'd died before the surgery was complete.
sentences.zh: 他在手术完成前就去世了。

sentences.en: What would the mother say when she saw her son at the funeral?
sentences.zh: 母亲在葬礼上看到儿子时会说些什么？

sentences.en: Again, the medical protocol was clear.
sentences.zh: 同样，医疗规程很明确。

sentences.en: Don had to turn the body over to Salvador's mother.
sentences.zh: 唐必须把遗体交给萨尔瓦多的母亲。

sentences.en: But he felt he couldn't bring himself to do this.
sentences.zh: 但他觉得自己怎么也做不到这一点。

sentences.en: It would only compound the first tragedy.
sentences.zh: 这只会让第一场悲剧雪上加霜。

sentences.en: He conferred with his team about finishing the surgery on Salvador.
sentences.zh: 他与团队商量要完成萨尔瓦多的手术。

sentences.en: I said it's against the law.
sentences.zh: 我说这是违法的。

sentences.en: But I think in this case, we should.
sentences.zh: 但我认为在这种情况下，我们应该这么做。

sentences.en: The rest of the team unanimously agreed.
sentences.zh: 团队其他人一致同意。

sentences.en: The little boy was brought back from the morgue.
sentences.zh: 小男孩被从太平间带了回来。

sentences.en: The child came back on a body bag.
sentences.zh: 孩子是用尸体袋运回来的。

sentences.en: And we did the whole thing as if the child was awake.
sentences.zh: 我们把整场手术做完，就像孩子还醒着一样。

sentences.en: I interviewed Don several times for the story.
sentences.zh: 为了这个故事，我采访了唐好几次。

sentences.en: I pushed hard to understand why he decided to operate on Salvador.
sentences.zh: 我极力追问，想弄明白他为什么决定给萨尔瓦多做手术。

sentences.en: What were you telling yourself, again, emotionally, that made you change your mind, that made you say,
sentences.zh: 你当时在心里对自己重复什么，在情感上是什么促使你改变主意，让你说出——

sentences.en: yes, I recognize there's a risk, but I have to do this?
sentences.zh: 是的，我知道有风险，但我必须这么做？

sentences.en: I thought, this is what I am for.
sentences.zh: 我想，这就是我存在的意义。

sentences.en: This is my purpose.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的使命。

sentences.en: And you said it's worth it.
sentences.zh: 而你说这是值得的。

sentences.en: I was standing there and I couldn't say no again.
sentences.zh: 我站在那里，无法再次拒绝。

sentences.en: I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我没有拒绝。

sentences.en: I couldn't.
sentences.zh: 我做不到。

sentences.en: When I made the decision, when I said that, let's go ahead and do the case, I didn't have any second thoughts.
sentences.zh: 当我做出决定、当我开口说“我们继续做这个手术”的时候，我没有任何犹豫。

sentences.en: Emotionally, I figured out that this is what I should do.
sentences.zh: 在情感上，我认定这就是我应该做的事。

sentences.en: Don still thinks about Salvador, has thought about him thousands of times over the years.
sentences.zh: 唐依然常常想起萨尔瓦多，这些年来已经想过成千上万次。

sentences.en: He's turned the case over in his head in every possible way.
sentences.zh: 他在脑海里把这个病例反反复复琢磨了无数遍。

sentences.en: I asked him over and over whether he felt regret.
sentences.zh: 我一次又一次地问他是否感到后悔。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Well, of course I do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当然后悔。

sentences.en: Of course I do.
sentences.zh: 我当然后悔。

sentences.en: Yes, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我后悔。

sentences.en: I mean, as you said just a minute ago, it was a mistake.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如你刚才所说，这是一个错误。

sentences.en: But I don't have, I'm not whipping myself.
sentences.zh: 但我没有，我没有在折磨自己。

sentences.en: Not whipping himself, Don says, because he was trying to do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 唐说他没有折磨自己，因为他当时是在做正确的事。

sentences.en: That's the reason he decided to operate.
sentences.zh: 这就是他决定动手术的原因。

sentences.en: That's the reason he completed the surgery after the child was dead.
sentences.zh: 这也是他在孩子死后仍然完成手术的原因。

sentences.en: What was more important than being on the right side of the law?
sentences.zh: 有什么比站在法律正确的一方更重要？

sentences.en: Doing the right thing.
sentences.zh: 那就是做正确的事。

sentences.en: By the mother and by the child.
sentences.zh: 对母亲负责，对孩子负责。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: No, you must always do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 不，你必须永远做正确的事。

sentences.en: That is the highest priority over all different laws and commandments or any of that thing.
sentences.zh: 这是高于一切法律、戒律或诸如此类事物的最高准则。

sentences.en: You have to do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 你必须做正确的事。

sentences.en: The day after Salvador died, Don Lobb was back in the operating room.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多去世的第二天，唐·洛布又回到了手术室。

sentences.en: There were more children waiting for surgery.
sentences.zh: 还有更多的孩子在等待手术。

sentences.en: He remembers looking out the windows of the sky.
sentences.zh: 他记得自己望向窗外的天空。

sentences.en: It was, he says, a perfect azure blue.
sentences.zh: 他说，那是一种完美的天蓝色。

sentences.en: At 10.30, the time when Salvador was to be buried, everyone on the team fell silent and paused.
sentences.zh: 上午十点半，也就是原本要安葬萨尔瓦多的时间，团队里的所有人都陷入了沉默与停顿。

sentences.en: There was no sound except for the whoosh of the anesthesia machine.
sentences.zh: 四周万籁俱寂，只有麻醉机的呼呼声。

sentences.en: When we think of foxes and hedgehogs, it's completely understandable that we want the best of both worlds.
sentences.zh: 当我们想到狐狸和刺猬时，想要鱼与熊掌兼得是完全可以理解的。

sentences.en: We love bold visionaries who take big risks, except when the risks don't work.
sentences.zh: 我们热爱敢冒大风险的果敢空想家，除非这些风险宣告失败。

sentences.en: At moments like that, we prefer the visionaries to be more cautious, filled with a little self-doubt.
sentences.zh: 在那种时刻，我们更希望这些空想家能更谨慎一些，带有一点自我怀疑。

sentences.en: Now, people don't always fall neatly into one camp or the other.
sentences.zh: 然而，人们并不总是能清晰地归入这两类人中的某一方。

sentences.en: Some of us can be both fox and hedgehog.
sentences.zh: 我们当中有些人既可以是狐狸，也可以是刺猬。

sentences.en: We can think and dream big, but also change course, adapt to circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我们可以有宏大的思考和梦想，但也能改变方向、顺应形势。

sentences.en: But it may be that we can't have our cake and eat it, too.
sentences.zh: 但鱼和熊掌可能真的不可兼得。

sentences.en: If we want the visionary Steve Jobs who helped usher in the age of the iPhone,
sentences.zh: 如果我们想要那个开启了iPhone时代的富有远见的史蒂夫·乔布斯，

sentences.en: we might also get the tyrannical CEO who nearly ran Apple computers into the ground in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 我们也可能会得到那个在20世纪80年代差点把苹果电脑公司搞垮的暴君式CEO。

sentences.en: It's odd to think of Gandhi and Napoleon and Churchill and Mao in the same breath,
sentences.zh: 把甘地、拿破仑、丘吉尔和毛泽东相提并论听起来有点奇怪，

sentences.en: but they are cut from the same cloth of messianic vision.
sentences.zh: 但他们都是由救世主式愿景的同一块布料裁剪而成的。

sentences.en: It's easy not to like the kind of people who create history's greatest failures.
sentences.zh: 人们很容易讨厌创造了历史最大失败的那些人。

sentences.en: But it turns out, they're also the people who produce our greatest triumphs.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，他们也正是创造了我们最大辉煌的人。

sentences.zh: 本周的节目由珍妮·施密特制作，塔拉·博伊尔剪辑。

sentences.en: Our team includes Raina Cohen, Parth Shah, Laura Querell, and Thomas Liu.
sentences.zh: 我们的团队成员包括雷娜·科恩、帕思·沙阿、劳拉·奎雷尔和托马斯·刘。

sentences.en: The music in today's show was composed by Ramteen Arablui.
sentences.zh: 今天节目的音乐由拉姆蒂安·阿拉布鲁伊创作。

sentences.en: Our unsung hero this week is another hedgehog and another Don.
sentences.zh: 我们本周的无名英雄是另一只刺猬，也是另一个唐。

sentences.en: Donald Drake was a colleague and friend of mine at the Philadelphia Inquirer many years ago.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·德雷克多年前曾是《费城问询报》我的同事兼朋友。

sentences.en: He taught me many things about writing and storytelling.
sentences.zh: 他教会了我很多关于写作和讲故事的道理。

sentences.en: We even wrote a play together.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至一起写过剧本。

sentences.en: Don died shortly after this episode first aired.
sentences.zh: 唐在这集节目首播后不久就去世了。

sentences.en: I'll never forget all that he taught me.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记他教给我的一切。

sentences.zh: 想收听更多《隐藏的大脑》，请在脸书和推特上关注我们。

sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢这集节目，请把它分享给一位朋友。

sentences.zh: 我们一直在寻找发现《隐藏的大脑》的新听众。
